Right now the archive files are named with the project name plus a date and the .zip extension, and the project names vary a lot in length, though most of them are short enough already, so this only hits a minority of projects. What I want is for the archive file names to stay within the server's limit, and I want them to keep the full project name wherever possible so people can tell what's inside at a glance. When the full name won't fit in that limit, use the project's short code from the projects list in place of the name. Please never chop a name off partway through, because the archive team searches by code, and a cut-off name is worse than the code. Please make sure the result is correct for every project, including ones right at the 32-character boundary.
